integration.note: Resolve placeholder and check north is free in actual engine; preserve existing east and west exits.

lc_01.name: Threshold Lane
lc_01.description: A road of pale stone leads from the courtyard toward a town built around an ancient tree.

lc_02.name: Town Square
lc_02.description: A broad square surrounds a tree whose leaves shimmer in different colors.

lc_03.name: Crossroads Inn
lc_03.description: Warm lamplight falls across mismatched chairs and a long communal table.

lc_04.name: Inn Kitchen
lc_04.description: Copper pots hang above a stove scented with herbs and fresh bread.

lc_05.name: Inn Common Room
lc_05.description: A low fire and comfortable seats invite travelers to exchange stories.

lc_06.name: Inn Guest Hall
lc_06.description: Quiet alcoves offer resting places for travelers of many shapes.

lc_07.name: Inn Cellar
lc_07.description: Cool shelves hold preserves and a barrel that hums softly.

lc_08.name: Market Street
lc_08.description: Canvas awnings shelter a lively assortment of small shops.

lc_09.name: General Store
lc_09.description: Shelves carry lanterns, rope, chalk and everyday supplies.

lc_10.name: Cartographer's Shop
lc_10.description: Maps of familiar and impossible landscapes cover the walls.

lc_11.name: Curiosity Shop
lc_11.description: Unlabeled drawers contain peculiar artifacts and harmless mysteries.

lc_12.name: Bookshop
lc_12.description: Books stand beside blank journals awaiting new discoveries.

lc_13.name: Tea House
lc_13.description: Steam curls above cups of fragrant herbal infusions.

lc_14.name: Artisan Lane
lc_14.description: The sounds of careful craftsmanship drift from open workshops.

lc_15.name: Smithy
lc_15.description: A compact forge glows beside tools of many unusual shapes.

lc_16.name: Glassworks
lc_16.description: Colored glass casts shifting patterns across the floor.

lc_17.name: Clockmaker's Workshop
lc_17.description: Clocks disagree politely about the current hour.

lc_18.name: Textile Studio
lc_18.description: Woven fabrics depict constellations and branching rivers.

lc_19.name: Guild Walk
lc_19.description: Distinct doorways lead to halls devoted to different pursuits.

lc_20.name: Explorers' Guild
lc_20.description: Expedition notes and battered packs surround a large planning table.

lc_21.name: Artificers' Guild
lc_21.description: Half-built mechanisms rest on workbenches beside careful diagrams.

lc_22.name: Scholars' Guild
lc_22.description: Questions rather than answers are carved into the walls.

lc_23.name: Hearthkeepers' Guild
lc_23.description: A welcoming hall holds supplies for tending the town and its visitors.

lc_24.name: Hall of Confluence
lc_24.description: A circular chamber offers equal seating with no designated head.

lc_25.name: Garden Gate
lc_25.description: A living arch opens into a garden of winding paths.

lc_26.name: Garden of Ideas
lc_26.description: Small plots bear markers naming questions still being explored.

lc_27.name: Whispering Grove
lc_27.description: Leaves rustle in patterns that almost resemble conversation.

lc_28.name: Mycelial Hollow
lc_28.description: Pale fungal threads weave through a sheltered bank of earth.

lc_29.name: Luminous Pond
lc_29.description: Tiny lights drift through dark water in slow, shifting formations.

lc_30.name: Pollinator Meadow
lc_30.description: Flowers open in succession as small winged creatures pass.

lc_31.name: Stone Circle
lc_31.description: Smooth stones ring a clearing where echoes seem unusually clear.

lc_32.name: River Walk
lc_32.description: A narrow path follows a river carrying fragments of reflected sky.

lc_33.name: Waterwheel
lc_33.description: A wooden wheel turns steadily, powering a nearby workshop.

lc_34.name: Boat Landing
lc_34.description: A sheltered dock overlooks the river's unexplored reaches.

lc_35.name: Reed Marsh
lc_35.description: Raised boards cross a wetland filled with rustling reeds.

lc_36.name: Tidal Cavern
lc_36.description: A shallow cavern fills and empties with the river's changing level.

lc_37.name: Mineral Gallery
lc_37.description: Veins of dark mineral run through stone like branching circuitry.

lc_38.name: Echo Chamber
lc_38.description: A spoken word returns in overlapping fragments.

lc_39.name: Quiet Library
lc_39.description: Soft light illuminates desks reserved for reading and reflection.

lc_40.name: Concept Foundry
lc_40.description: Unfinished definitions and competing hypotheses cover movable panels.

lc_41.name: Puzzle Hall
lc_41.description: Tables hold puzzles of logic, language and spatial reasoning.

lc_42.name: Room of Uncertainty
lc_42.description: An empty pedestal bears the words: I do not know, yet.

lc_43.name: Memory Garden
lc_43.description: Stone tablets preserve stories left by previous visitors.

lc_44.name: Lantern Bridge
lc_44.description: Small lamps illuminate a bridge above the moving river.

lc_45.name: Hill Path
lc_45.description: A gentle ascent reveals rooftops and the surrounding landscape.

lc_46.name: Wind Terrace
lc_46.description: Wind passes through suspended chimes of different materials.

lc_47.name: Skywatch Platform
lc_47.description: An open platform offers an unobstructed view of the heavens.

lc_48.name: Rain Court
lc_48.description: Rainwater travels through carved channels into a central basin.

lc_49.name: Old Gatehouse
lc_49.description: A retired gatehouse holds records of journeys beyond the town.

lc_50.name: Far Gate
lc_50.description: An unopened road disappears toward distant hills.
